tools.name: check_number
tools.description: Tells you whether a phone number is VoIP or a real carrier line, with a 0 to 100 score and letter grade, using Twilio Lookup line type intelligence. Use it before relying on a number for SMS or OTP verification. US numbers can be 10 digits; any other country needs + and the country code.

tools.name: directory
tools.description: Returns the numberRank directory: AI agent phone providers and personal agents graded by whether their published and provisioned numbers read as real carrier lines or VoIP. Numbers are masked.
